source.title: Ulster Herald, 13 June 1964, p. 11 ("How contests for R.D.C. seats went"); Irish News, 6 June 1964, p. 3 ("Rural council elections: eleven sitting members returned for Newry Rural Council")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish News Archive)
source.check: the two counts read in the Ulster Herald of 13 June 1964 and in the Irish News of 6 June 1964, which agree; the nominations and deemed returns from the Ulster Herald of 23 May 1964, p. 11.

note: Triennial election of Omagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Two contests, in Carrickmore and Fintona; the outgoing Nationalist members were returned in both. The remaining 37 divisions were uncontested; in four of them no nomination was received and the retiring member was deemed re-elected. The counting in the two contests took place on the Friday morning. Printed: 'Carrickmore division - McKeone 138; John P. Gervin 131. Majority 7. Total electorate 295. Spoiled votes 1. Total poll 270. Percentage poll 92.' McKeone had been six years on the council.
